verdict: The editorial skeleton is real and at moments genuinely excellent — the becoming story pages (WEIGHT kicker → "holding steady this week." → one large visual) are Kinfolk-grade spreads no competitor ships, and the tracked-caps kicker register is correctly sized and quiet. But the system runs without an enforcer: two serifs compete in the same optical band against the system's own written doctrine, the scale is a ~30-size ramp instead of a ladder, the italic signature is spent on everything including numerals the founder explicitly ruled against, and glossy sticker-tile iconography drags the highest-traffic screen from Cereal toward Claire's. It currently reads as one magazine art-directed by three different hands — a strong voice, diluted by its own call sites.

keep.what: The JKStoryPage grammar: tracked-caps kicker → full-sentence lowercase serif headline with terminal period → one large visual → quiet caption/door (BecomingStoryPages.swift:16-66; screens 04/05/06: WEIGHT / "holding steady this week.", SUGAR INTAKE / "your sugar intake came down this week.")
keep.why: This is authentic magazine-spread DNA — deck, standfirst, plate. The full sentence with a period makes data read as an editor's judgment, not a dashboard label. It is the single strongest expression of the north star and should become the template every other surface conforms to.

keep.what: The tracked-caps kicker register itself: 11pt DM Sans Medium, ~+0.18em, cocoaTertiary (Typo.captionTracked) — SIGNALS, WEIGHT, CLOSING THE DAY, YOUR COACH · MONDAY
keep.why: Correct luxury-editorial convention (Cereal/Acne Paper), correctly subordinated in size and color to the hero line. It never shouts. The device is right; only its over-assignment to too many roles needs fixing.

keep.what: Serif-number-as-headline moments: the chat trend card's 163.6 at display size with small unit (07_jeni_chat), and the STARTED/NOW/GOAL sans stat row with tracked-caps specimen labels (04_becoming_p1)
keep.why: This is the Aesop specimen-label convention executed properly — the number becomes editorial content, the label becomes furniture. It's the strongest argument that data can be beautiful here without charts shouting.

keep.what: Chat correspondence furniture: italic-serif lowercase date dividers ("friday, july 17") between hairlines, the HER FILE pill, jeni masthead (07_jeni_chat)
keep.why: Turns a chat log into a correspondence page — precisely the "companion, not tool" feeling the north star asks for, achieved purely typographically.

keep.what: The lowercase full-sentence coach voice at hero scale ("back after 10 days. this is day 12, not day zero.", 01_today_top)
keep.why: Confident, distinctive, ownable. The period is doing brand work — statements land as editorial standfirsts. No other app in this category talks like this at this size.

problems.title: Two serifs compete in the same optical band, against the system's own law
problems.evidence: Tokens.swift:6-14 declares JeniHeroSerif = ALL display serif ≥19pt and Fraunces = "micro slots only (11pt eyebrow/ornament) + body-copy italic punch words"; Tokens.swift:242-249 records that Fraunces FAILED as the display face. Grep census: Fraunces at 22pt ×35, 26pt ×25, 28pt ×14 call sites — e.g. PlankAIApp.swift:1031, StepsPulseTile.swift:105/448, BreathworkSessionView.swift:560, FoodSettingsView.swift:105, JKBreathField.swift:309 — while JeniHeroSerif runs the same 22-30pt band.
problems.detail: Playfair's ball terminals and Fraunces's wedge terminals are different magazines. When adjacent surfaces set 24-28pt headlines in different serifs, the app reads as several publications interleaved — the single biggest source of the "several competing voices" feeling. THEME.md §2 still teaches Fraunces-as-display (display 56 Light, title 32 SemiBold), so the canonical brand doc is actively generating wrong new work.

problems.title: The type scale is a ramp, not a ladder — ~30 serif sizes, tokens bypassed at call sites
problems.evidence: Size census: JeniHeroSerif at 30 distinct sizes (17pt ×19, 23pt ×5, 21, 27, 46, 54, 58…); Fraunces at 28 sizes; DM Sans at 20 (incl. 10.5, 12.5). Even flagship components hardcode: JKStoryPage headline .custom(…size: 30) (BecomingStoryPages.swift:35), JKMasthead hero 28 (JKMasthead.swift:60), JKReadingDay 28/23 — none exist in Typo.
problems.detail: A magazine ships ~6 sizes per issue; that constraint IS the coherence. Off-ladder sizes (17 vs 16 vs 19; 28 vs 30 vs 32) are why screens feel subtly unrelated even when the grammar matches. The Typo enum already contains too many near-duplicate registers (56/44/38/36/34/32/30/28/26/24/22/19) and views still invent more — there is no enforcement mechanism at all.

problems.title: The italic-punch signature is diluted to wallpaper — including italic numerals the founder explicitly killed
problems.evidence: 01_today_top shows 4+ italic moments above the fold: day-pill "day 12" set in Fraunces-SemiBoldItalic 17 (JKMasthead.swift:99 — an italic NUMBER), "finding steady", hero "day 12" italic (number again), ONE THING "next". TodayStateBand.swift:50/231/381 sets "~600 left" in JeniHeroSerif-Italic 16 — Tokens.swift:79-81 records the founder's ruling: "i don't like italic numbers… for numerals it dies." 03_today_evening sets an entire line italic ("tonight's plan, if cravings hit:"). 20 italic call sites in BecomingView.swift alone; THEME.md's own rule is ONE italic punch word per surface.
problems.detail: The italic word is the brand's voice signal. At current density it stops being a punch and becomes texture, and italic digits (12, ~600) are the exact failure the numeral doctrine was written to prevent — Playfair italic figures wobble and read decorative where numbers must read factual.

problems.title: JeniHeroSerif set below its own 16pt floor — Playfair-650 muds at caption sizes
problems.evidence: Tokens.swift:11 — "Never below 16pt." Violations: JKGauges.swift:128 (13pt), BecomingTrendCanvas.swift:174 (13pt), SnapResultView.swift:427/434 (13pt), OV5ScreensClose.swift:60 (13pt), JKGauges.swift:383, JKSignalVisuals.swift:1278, BreathworkSessionView.swift:218, WeeklyReceiptCard.swift:117, CancellationWinbackSheet.swift:162-163 (15pt) — ~15 sites at 13-15pt.
problems.detail: A 650-weight display face at 13pt clogs counters and fills joins on device — it reads as smudged print. Luxury dies at detail level first; these are exactly the small moments (gauge captions, trend annotations) where the premium signal is either confirmed or quietly lost.

problems.title: Sticker-tile iconography contradicts the editorial register on the highest-traffic screen
problems.evidence: 01/02_today: rows lead with glossy 3D stickers in pastel tiles — candy=lesson, shoe=steps, heart-padlock=weigh-in ("trend check"), balloon-dog=move, bubble=breathe (mapping at ProgramDayPrescription.swift:115-128); glossy peach seal on the cocoa ONE THING card. THEME.md §3 locks sticker scatter to the 3 earned moments (welcome / plan reveal / graduation). Four icon languages coexist on one screen: 3D stickers, the flat moon glyph on the overnight row, SF-symbol camera FAB, flat black tab glyphs.
problems.detail: Vogue does not use candy clip-art as section markers. The semantics also misfire: candy iconography in an app whose becoming page says "your sugar intake came down" is off-message; a padlock on the weigh-in row connotes locked/withheld. Judged against the north star (calm, premium, Apple-like), the daily-chrome stickers are the main force pulling Today from editorial toward scrapbook kitsch — while the moon glyph on the overnight row quietly proves a calmer mark language already works.

problems.title: Number typography has no constitution — the same metric wears three voices
problems.evidence: Protein renders as serif-accent ledger "62 of 90g" (03_today_evening) and sans "protein 62 of 90g" (02_today_bottom). Kcal: sans-bold "860" + sans "~1,473" + italic-serif "~600 left" in one line. Weight: serif "163.6" + italic-serif "lb" on becoming (04) but sans "lb" in the chat card (07). Steps: semibold "7,500 steps" title vs right-aligned regular "6,420".
problems.detail: Tokens.swift:82-98 already defines the correct hierarchy (numeralHero serif / numeralStat DM Sans tabular / numeralMeta units / statLabel) — surfaces simply don't follow it. Numbers are this app's actual product content; until units and figures pick one voice per role, the data layer reads assembled, not published.

problems.title: One kicker voice does six jobs, flattening hierarchy — and tracked caps wrap
problems.evidence: Same tracked-caps register serves dates (MONDAY, JULY 27), section labels (TODAY'S FOOD · SIGNALS), card labels (THE ONE THING), door/CTA leads ("OPEN her plates ↗", "THIRTY SECONDS log a weigh-in ↗"), stat sublabels (A DAY, AVERAGE), and citation pills. In 08_window_sheet the pill "CELL METABOLISM, 2022" wraps to two lines.
problems.detail: When furniture, wayfinding, and actions all whisper in identical caps, the eye can't rank them — dates read as sections, buttons read as labels. Tracked caps must never wrap; a two-line letterspaced pill is a print error in editorial terms.

problems.title: Generated hero lines have no rag control and inconsistent leading cadence
problems.evidence: 01_today_top breaks "…this is day 12, not / day zero." — line ends on "not" (weak break) at headline scale. JKStoryPage uses .lineSpacing(-2) at 30pt (BecomingStoryPages.swift:40) vs the locked Playfair cadence −0.505×30 ≈ −15 (Tokens.swift:16-18) — becoming heroes sit visibly looser than Today's clamped hero.
problems.detail: Jeni's lines come from DailyBriefEngine, so every break is machine-set; without non-breaking joins the app will routinely hang prepositions and negations at line ends at 28-34pt. And the signature "lines almost touch" leading currently lives on only one tab, so the two flagship surfaces don't share the brand's most distinctive spatial gesture.

recommendations.title: Adopt a published 7-slot type ladder and delete every off-ladder size
recommendations.detail: Collapse Typo to: Display 44 (mastheads), Hero 32 (screen insight sentence), Reading 24 (sheets/pull-quotes/ledger accents), Body 16 (DM Sans), Meta 13 (DM Sans Medium), Kicker 11 (tracked caps), plus Numeral roles mapped onto the same sizes. Migrate the ~80 .custom(size:) literal call sites (JKStoryPage 30→32, JKMasthead 28→32 or 24, JKReadingDay 28/23→24, all 17/21/23/27pt serifs to neighbors). Enforce with a SwiftLint custom rule banning `custom("JeniHeroSerif` / `custom("Fraunces` / `custom("DMSans` with a size literal outside Tokens.swift. This one constraint makes all nine screens read as one publication.

recommendations.title: Retire Fraunces above 18pt; one display serif only
recommendations.detail: Fraunces survives in exactly two roles per the existing doctrine: 11pt eyebrow/roman ornament, and the SemiBoldItalic punch word inside DM Sans body copy (JKReadingDay's 13.5-16pt body punches are correct). Re-set every 22-28pt+ Fraunces SemiBold headline (PlankAIApp.swift:1031/1992, StepsPulseTile.swift:105/448, BreathworkSessionView.swift:560, FoodSettingsView.swift:105, CoachIntroView.swift:273, paywall sites) in JeniHeroSerif at the nearest ladder slot. Then rewrite THEME.md §2, which still teaches the pre-swap Fraunces display system — the doc drift is actively producing wrong new screens.

recommendations.title: Write the numeral constitution and apply it app-wide
recommendations.detail: One rule per role, honoring the founder's recorded ruling: hero/story numerals = JeniHeroSerif ROMAN, never italic (163.6, 62, day counts); row/ledger numerals = DM Sans Medium tabular (.monospacedDigit); units always DM Sans, cocoaSecondary, roman ("lb", "kcal", "g") — kill the italic-serif "lb" on becoming so it matches the chat card. Delete every italic-serif numeral: TodayStateBand.swift:50/231/381 ("~600 left"), JKMasthead.swift:99 (Fraunces-italic day-pill number → roman serif pill). Numbers are the product; they must read factual, not decorative.

recommendations.title: Ration the italic to ONE punch word per screen
recommendations.detail: Audit each surface to a single italic moment — the insight word only ("steady", "down", "next"). Today top currently spends 4+ (day pill, "finding steady", hero "day 12", card "next"): keep the hero's, set the rest roman. Full-line italics ("tonight's plan, if cravings hit:") become roman with a kicker above. Chart annotations and week-line qualifiers go roman serif or sans meta. Scarcity is what makes the device a signature; today's density has already spent it.

recommendations.title: Replace daily-chrome sticker tiles with one quiet mark language
recommendations.detail: Rows drop the glossy 3D tiles for 16-18pt cocoa line glyphs in the moon's register (the overnight row already proves it works), or drop leading marks entirely and let the mixed-weight row typography carry (the more Cereal move). The peach seal on THE ONE THING becomes a typographic seal (small italic initial or tracked word). Painterly stickers return to being exclusive to the 3 earned moments per THEME.md's own lock. FLAG — founder decision: sticker moments are a brand lock; this narrows their surface area to the earned moments rather than removing them, but it changes the daily face of the app and needs founder sign-off.

recommendations.title: Separate kicker roles so hierarchy re-forms
recommendations.detail: Tracked caps = section kickers only (WEIGHT, SIGNALS, CLOSING THE DAY). Dates move to the chat-divider convention already in the system: lowercase italic serif ("monday, july 27") — warmer and instantly distinguishable from sections. Doors/CTAs drop the caps lead: "log a weigh-in ↗" as a reading-register line (the THIRTY SECONDS/OPEN prefixes currently make buttons read as labels). Stat sublabels stay statLabel at 10-11pt, one optical step below section kickers. Add a no-wrap rule for all tracked caps (fixedSize or shortened strings — fixes the two-line CELL METABOLISM, 2022 pill).

recommendations.title: Add rag control and one leading cadence to generated display lines
recommendations.detail: In DailyBriefEngine/JKStoryPage output: join the final two words with U+00A0, keep the italic word glued to its following word, prefer breaks after clause punctuation — eliminates "not /" line-end breaks at headline scale. Apply the locked cadence (−0.505 × size) to every ≥24pt serif stack so becoming's heroes clamp like Today's and the brand's signature near-touching leading is app-wide, not one-tab.

recommendations.title: Enforce the 16pt serif floor
recommendations.detail: Re-set the ~15 sub-16pt JeniHeroSerif sites (JKGauges.swift:128/383, BecomingTrendCanvas.swift:174, SnapResultView.swift:427/434, OV5ScreensClose.swift:60, CancellationWinbackSheet.swift:162-163, WeeklyReceiptCard.swift:117, etc.) in Fraunces SemiBoldItalic (if a body punch) or DM Sans meta (if furniture). Cover it with the same lint rule from the ladder work so the floor can't erode again.

one_transformative_move: Enact a one-page "type constitution" and enforce it mechanically: one display serif above 18pt (JeniHeroSerif; Fraunces demoted to 11pt eyebrows + body punch words), a 7-slot size ladder, one italic word per screen, numerals always roman with one voice per role — backed by a lint rule that bans font-size literals outside Tokens.swift. The grammar of a beautiful magazine already exists in this app (the story pages prove it); the transformation is not designing a new voice but forcing the existing three voices to collapse into the best one, which is exactly what will make the whole product read as one calm, confident editor — the typographic embodiment of "Jeni is already paying attention."
